commands.name: let
commands.description: Bind a numeric variable. Expressions can reference other variables, constants, and functions.

commands.name: arc
commands.signature: arc cx cy r startDeg endDeg
commands.description: Draw an arc. Angles in degrees.

commands.name: polyline
commands.description: Connected line segments. Requires an even number of coordinates.

commands.name: color
commands.description: Set stroke color. Named colors use the PICO-8 palette. For a specific hex, use a quoted string: color "#ff0000".

commands.name: layer
commands.description: Start a new layer. All subsequent shapes belong to it until another layer command. Optional color sets the layer's default color.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear all shapes (layers keep their state).
